about: Hand-recorded provenance of the drishyam_dacl10k weights: only what the files themselves show, null where nothing was recorded. The training run wrote no run_info.json; this file has another name because scripts/install_model.sh reads run_info.json as the notebook's own output. The install script copies the 'known' text into models/README.md while the installed ONNX matches sha256.
known: What is known about this run without it (`drishyam_dacl10k.provenance.json`): the notebook ran on Colab (the cell in `training/README.md`, section 4; the install commit 03af85b says so). `drishyam_dacl10k.metrics.json` holds 24 epochs (0 to 23) of 433 steps each, which is 6,935 // 16, the whole dacl10k train split at the default batch size 16 with `drop_last`. Epoch 23 is the last of them, so the selection above picked the final checkpoint. The exported graph is a UNet (its decoder nodes are `decoder/blocks.0` to `.4`). Not recorded: package versions, the notebook source hash, the flags, the seed and the run time.
